Hangman Game

Classic Hangman: guess the hidden word letter by letter before the drawing is complete.

Category: –  •  Wrong guesses: 0 / 6

📖 How to use

  1. A random word is picked and its category shown.
  2. Click letters A–Z to guess.
  3. Wrong guesses draw the hangman, one part at a time.
  4. Guess the word before 6 wrong guesses.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many wrong guesses do I get?

You get 6 wrong guesses: head, body, two arms and two legs. The 6th wrong guess ends the game.

Where do the words come from?

About 100 everyday English words across animals, food, sports, objects, nature and professions.

Can I skip a word?

Click “New word” any time for a fresh word and a clean gallows.
